hypotheses.G1_conditional_program_beats_global32: At least one routed hard program reduces mean exact KL by at least 20% versus the one-by-32 program on every corpus.
hypotheses.G2_best_granularity_is_interior: The lowest geometric-mean hard-routing KL is achieved by 2x16, 4x8, or 8x4 rather than either endpoint.
hypotheses.G3_rank4_or_less_can_reach_gate: At least one hard-routed program with active rank at most four has median exact KL at most 0.005 on every corpus.
hypotheses.G4_hard_execution_matches_soft: For the overall winning granularity, hard-routing mean KL is at most 10% above soft-routing KL on every corpus.
hypotheses.G5_winner_transfers_across_corpora: The same granularity has the lowest hard-routing mean KL on FineWeb, WikiText, and TinyStories.
hypotheses.G6_conditional_gain_is_not_only_local: Every multi-expert setting that improves opposite-half Fisher over 1x32 also improves geometric-mean exact KL across the three external corpora.
